reason: My whole business lives on my Google and Tripadvisor stars, and I am not putting a QR code on every table that invites tourists to grade each dish one by one. Even with 3 months free, I don't want to hand a stranger's platform a new place for bad ratings about me.
objection: One tired tourist rates my khachapuri badly on a busy day and it sits there forever under my name, and I have no say over it. Plus another fee on top of every card payment when my margins are already thin.
would_change_my_mind: If the dish ratings came only to me privately, as feedback, and nothing was published unless I chose it.
